title: Golden-file eval for planners
problem: How do we prove renderer output quality is testable?

approaches.name: Dedicated eval file
approaches.thesis: One file owns both renderers' output-quality assertions.
approaches.whyLens: Testability requires an eval that fails loudly on regression, independent of the two renderers' own unit tests.
approaches.whatBreaks: Nothing - the file is additive and owns no shared code.
approaches.whenToPick: When ownership must stay disjoint from existing renderer tests.
approaches.mutualExclusivity: Complements A2/A3, does not require picking one exclusively.

approaches.name: Fold into existing test files
approaches.thesis: Add output-quality assertions directly to render-plan.test.js / render-brainstorm.test.js.

approaches.name: Snapshot testing library
approaches.thesis: Adopt a snapshot-testing dependency for whole-file diffing.
approaches.whenToPick: When output shape churns often and a maintained diff tool pays for itself.

recommendedDefault.reason: Keeps file ownership disjoint from T1/T3's test files while staying dependency-free.
